name: Thailand

must_know: The head is considered the sacred highest part of the body, so never touch anyone's head; feet are lowest and should never point at Buddha.
fun_fact: Songkran, the Thai New Year in mid-April, transforms the entire nation into the world's biggest friendly water fight celebration.
